q: What is the age limit for the Chairperson of the Central Administrative Tribunal?
e: The Chairperson of the Central Administrative Tribunal holds office for a term of four years or until attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier; the old post of Vice-Chairman no longer exists under this regime (Members retire at 67). (Source: Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021, Section 5; effective 13.08.2021.)
